final_text:
Added an order history page with order cancellation support for pending orders.

What changed:
- Added a `PATCH /api/orders/:id/cancel` endpoint on the server.
- Changed new orders to start as `pending` so they can be cancelled before shipment.
- Cancel endpoint restores product stock and marks the order as `cancelled`.
- Updated the orders UI to show order status and a **Cancel Order** button when an order is still pending.
- Kept the existing order history view and navigation, so users can view details and cancel from the same page.

Note: I wasn’t able to run TypeScript lint successfully in this container because `tsc` isn’t installed there.
